# Puffin Ship

> Puffin Ship is a video automation platform that turns long recordings into on-brand short clips. Teams upload the webinars, product demos, livestreams and podcast episodes they already record, and Puffin Ship finds the moments worth posting, crops them to vertical, adds captions, trims dead air and applies their brand. One recording becomes a week of clips for LinkedIn, YouTube Shorts, Instagram Reels and TikTok.

## How it works

1. **Upload a recording**: a webinar, a product demo, a livestream, a podcast episode. The video file you already have.
2. **It finds the moments worth posting**: Puffin Ship reads what was said and what was on screen, then pulls out the clips that stand on their own.
3. **Get clips ready to post**: each clip is cropped to vertical, captioned, trimmed of dead air and styled to the brand. The team reviews them, then posts.

## Why teams use it

- **One recording in, a week of shorts out.** It finds the moments people will actually watch, frames the speaker for vertical, adds captions and cuts the pauses.
- **The same look on every clip.** A template sets the fonts, colors, captions and layout once. Clip two hundred looks like clip one, whoever on the team made it. A run can stop and wait for review before it finishes, and nothing is posted on anyone's behalf.
- **Built to automate.** Runs, templates and files are available through an API, so teams can start runs from their own systems on their own schedule. AI assistants such as Claude can drive Puffin Ship directly over MCP.

## Who it's for

- **Marketing teams with webinars and demos** (the main audience): teams that already record a webinar, a launch demo or a customer session every week and want a steady run of clips from each one without adding an editor.
- **Agencies**: run the same system for every client, each in its own workspace with its own template and look.
- **Streamers and podcasters**: every stream or episode becomes highlights for Shorts, Reels and TikTok without scrubbing through hours of footage.

## Set up for you

Teams that would rather not set it up themselves can have the Puffin Ship team do it, as much or as little as they need: building templates around their brand, fitting Puffin Ship into how they already work, or running it for them and handing over finished clips. Ask through the form at https://puffinship.com/#contact.

## Pricing

There is one plan for everyone, priced by usage. There are no tiers and no per-seat charges, and every workspace gets every feature. New accounts start with credit included, so the first clips can be made before spending anything. The bill shows what each template and each teammate used.
